 Mr. Rajesh Tripathy,
 Addl.

 Coram:
 Justice S.K. Sahoo
 Order
Order No. 21.04.2023
01.

This matter is taken up through Hybrid arrangement (video conferencing/physical mode).
This is an application under section 439 Cr.P.C. for grant of bail to the petitioner in connection with T.R. Case No. 106 of 2016 arising out of Koraput Town P.S. Case No. 143 of 2016 pending on the file of learned Additional Sessions Judge -cum- Special Judge, POCSO, Jeypore for commission of offences punishable under sections 366/376(2)(i)(n) of the Indian Penal Code read with section 6 of the POCSO Act.
Learned counsel for the petitioner submits that earlier the petitioner was on bail and due to non- taking of steps in the Court below on the date fixed, non-bailable warrant of arrest was issued against the // 2 // petitioner, by virtue of which he was taken into custody on 13.12.2022.
He further submits that the petitioner is ready and willing to cooperate with the learned trial Court for early disposal of the case.
Learned counsel for the State, on the other hand, opposed the prayer for bail.

Considering the submissions made by the learned counsel for the respective parties, the fact that the petitioner was earlier on bail and taking into account the period of detention in judicial custody, I Siba Sankar Bagh vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party on 21 April, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151713298/
1 am inclined to grant of bail to the petitioner.

entities.text: I Siba Sankar Bagh vs State Of Odisha .... Opp. Party
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
Let the petitioner be released on bail in the aforesaid case on furnishing a bail bond of Rs. 50,000/-
(rupees fifty thosuand) with two local solvent sureties each for the like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Court in seisin over the matter with further terms and conditions as the learned Court may deem just and proper including the condition that the petitioner shall appear before the trial Court on each date when the case would be posted for trial.
Violation of any of the terms and conditions fixed shall entail cancellation of bail.
The BLAPL is accordingly disposed of.

( S.K. Sahoo) Judge P // 3 //
